documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Outcome Of Board Meeting - Disclosure Pursuant To Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 Regarding The Proposed Incorporation Of A Wholly Owned Subsidiary

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported its financial and operational highlights for Q2 and H1 FY27, showcasing significant revenue and profit growth alongside an expanded manufacturing footprint. Revenue from operations for H1 FY27 reached ₹1,367.15 crore, while profit after tax stood at ₹73.47 crore. The company operationalized its Kandivali facility, expanding capacity, and marked strategic entries into bridal jewellery and new lightweight collections. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported a 64.9% year-on-year revenue increase to INR 548.5 Crores for Q1 FY27. The company expanded its annual production capacity to 4,000 kg through its Kandivali facility and has strategically entered the bridal jewellery segment to meet rising demand.

guidance.claim: The company will continue to look for opportunities to enter various gold jewellery segments.
guidance.quote: Will continue to seize opportunities to enter into different gold jewellery segments

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: We remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.

guidance.claim: Management plans to increase mangalsutra sales by approximately 33% to 35% within the current year.
guidance.quote: Within this year, we will increase our mangalsutra sales by one-third, i.e., approximately 33% to 35%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to make bridal jewellery production equivalent to mangalsutra production within two to three years.
guidance.quote: In the next two or three years, we will parallelly start making bridal jewellery equivalent to mangalsutra, because bridal jewellery accounts for 60% of the entire jewellery industry.

guidance.claim: Management projects a value CAGR of 30% over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Therefore, looking ahead over the next two to three years, our projected CAGR in terms of value is easily achievable within the 30% range.

demand_outlook.claim: Expansion by corporate clients is expected to generate more demand for the company's products.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: There is increasing demand for organized jewellery retail in the Marathwada and Vidarbha regions.
demand_outlook.quote: These two high-potential markets are witnessing increased demand for organized jewellery retail.

demand_outlook.claim: Bridal jewellery is identified as a high-growth category for the company.
demand_outlook.quote: Bridal jewellery, being a high-growth category, enhances our overall value proposition.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong domestic demand and rupee depreciation have contributed to rising gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Global gold price movement, rupee depreciation, and strong domestic demand have all played a significant role.

demand_outlook.claim: The volume of weddings in India is increasing by approximately 7% to 8% annually.
demand_outlook.quote: Thus, with the volume of weddings increasing by approximately 7% to 8% annually, the gold jewellery industry is also advancing and expanding at a corresponding pace.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately ₹15 crore was invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune to coordinate operations.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened a new branch office in Pune to expand its footprint in Western India.
capex_expansion.quote: As a part of our ongoing expansion strategy, we successfully inaugurated a new branch office in Pune, a move that has significantly enhanced our geographic footprint in Western India from Marathwada to Vidarbha regions.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing capacity was increased from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs in the fourth quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Firstly, we executed a major expansion of our manufacturing capabilities during the fourth quarter, resulting in a meaningful increase in production capacity from 2,500 kgs to 4,000 kgs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has strategically entered the bridal jewellery segment.
capex_expansion.quote: Secondly, we made a strategic entry into the bridal jewellery segment, which represents a natural extension to our core mangalsutra business.

capex_expansion.claim: New factories were built and equipped with new technology and machinery.
capex_expansion.quote: And recently you must have known that we have built new factories, so we had to make some expenditure to install some machinery and all that new technology in that factory as per the new factory.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

margins_costs.claim: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin decreased by 350 basis points to 8.9% in Q1 FY27.
Gross profit margin for the fourth quarter was 8.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit margin stood at 8.9%, expanded by 65 basis points over year-to-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was 6.2%, a decrease of 41 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin were at 6.2%, down by 41 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Full year EBITDA margin increased by 61 basis points to 7.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was at 7.1%, up by 61 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Gold hedging resulted in a notional loss due to rising gold prices.
margins_costs.quote: Since we hedge gold, it results in a notional loss because if we have hedged the gold at whatever price we have bought it at in MCX, whatever additional payment we have to make due to increase in the price of gold, that actually results in loss.

margins_costs.claim: Outright sales are considered more beneficial for profitability than job work.
margins_costs.quote: Therefore, an outright sale is always more beneficial for us than undertaking job work.

orders_capacity.claim: Actual capacity utilization is 87% with a blended capacity for the full year of 2625 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an integrated manufacturing facility with a capacity of 4,000 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

orders_capacity.claim: The company uses outsourced production to complement its in-house capacity to meet demand.
orders_capacity.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity for the next financial year is 4,000 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: For the next financial year, our available installed capacity stays at 4,000 kgs, and we expect to further ramp up production in the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Effective capacity utilization for FY26 was 87%.
orders_capacity.quote: As a result, the blended capacity for the year stood at 2,625 kgs, leading to an effective capacity utilization of 87% for FY '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for the fourth quarter reached 500 kgs.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the fourth quarter stood at 500 kgs, up 16% Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: The company serves 1,333 clients globally for its mangalsutra business.
orders_capacity.quote: For mangalsutra, we have 1,333 clients all over India and the world.

orders_capacity.claim: Corporate clients accounted for 49% of full-year revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: For the full year, the revenue contribution from the corporate clients stood at 49% and non-corporate clients at 51%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's listing provided funds to enable growth.
capital_allocation.quote: Listing of the company enabled growth funds

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately 30% of bullion requirements are met through the Advanced Gold Model provided by corporate clients.
capital_allocation.quote: About 30% of our bullion requirements is fulfilled through AGM

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity ratio for FY26 was 0.27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-equity ratio for financial '26 remained at 0.27.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's business is subject to risks from the performance of the Indian and international economies.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets

risks_headwinds.claim: The gold import duty has been raised back to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Talking about the gold price duty, gold duty was initially set at 15%, later reduced to 6%, and has now been raised again to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Managing over 1,300 companies leads to erratic payment schedules and cash flow challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Currently, since I work with over 1,300 companies, managing them all is challenging; their payment schedules can be erratic, sometimes early, sometimes late, which can lead to a disruptive churning effect on our cash flow.

management_commitments.claim: The production from the current capacity is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to look for opportunities to enter various gold jewellery segments.
management_commitments.quote: Will continue to seize opportunities to enter into different gold jewellery segments

management_commitments.claim: The company will deliver approximately 30% growth.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to our guidance of delivering approximately 30% growth over the next two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: The company will increase mangalsutra sales by one-third.
management_commitments.quote: Within this year, we will increase our mangalsutra sales by one-third, i.e., approximately 33% to 35%.

management_commitments.claim: Bridal jewellery production will be parallel to mangalsutra production.
management_commitments.quote: In the next two or three years, we will parallelly start making bridal jewellery equivalent to mangalsutra, because bridal jewellery accounts for 60% of the entire jewellery industry.

management_commitments.claim: The company will convert a significant portion of operations to organized/outright sales.
management_commitments.quote: Within approximately two quarters, we will have converted a significant portion of our operations.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
